pointer.guideText: Choose Laser above the camera and point a red laser at an object. Red laser uses a trained AI model. Both the object and the spot must be visible. Hold to confirm its name. Only enabled object types supported by the object model can be recognised. If the spot is missing, bring the object closer. LEDs and reflections can still cause false detections.

guide.step1Text: Press “Turn on my camera” and allow camera access. Everyone uses the camera on their own device; the server only receives frames to recognise.
guide.step2Text: Choose Finger or Laser above the camera. Put your fingertip or laser spot on an object and hold until the confirmation ring turns green.
guide.step3Text: The object name, confidence and history update by themselves. Take snapshots, export the history as CSV or turn on spoken names in Settings.
guide.tipsText: Keep the scene well lit, avoid covering objects and keep your fingertip clearly in view. The confidence shown belongs to the object detection, not to the accuracy of your pointing.
guide.privacyText: Frames are only used for recognition and then discarded — never saved as photos or video. Settings and history stay in your browser.
